name: 06_doc_summaries
task: Summarise a long document into a fixed house format
provenance_detail: INPUTS are the owner's own articles from the approved corpus. TARGETS are summaries written by this lane to a fixed shape — so this dataset teaches STRUCTURE and compression, NOT his register, and any worked example built from it must not claim otherwise. That is deliberate: the design put a non-voice task in the set so a prospect whose problem is volume rather than tone can see themselves.
